scope: Read-only financial source review of one saved Time entry and a server-side filter for saved review notes.

crmSql.scope: Affected Time, Billing and PowerOffice test classes, including the 13 new financial-review cases; not all CRM integration tests.

crmBrowser.scope: Current Time/Service/Activities/Parasol regressions. Critical finance source-review workflow uses the real SQL-backed API in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit; two new phone accessibility cases use a controlled synthetic report in Chromium light/dark.

invariants: Five read permissions are all required before lookup; no role gains this screen through a single permission.
Repeated GET preserves Time/Contracts/Billing row versions, balances, audit and outbox.
Cancellation releases the actual SQL row/month read lease.
Saved-note filtering precedes totals and cursor paging and retains existing employee scope.
Closed, deleted and foreign bank references cannot become a false clean result or leak a foreign bank name.
Old fully returned receipts and exported allocation revisions are interpreted explicitly.
Refresh, failure, permission loss and entry changes remove previous facts; text is not rendered as HTML.
No financial repair, approval, withdrawal, schema migration, production dependency or provider call is added.

retainedDiagnostics.resolution: Fixture object was imported as a function; corrected the adapter without weakening assertions.
Validated the existing SQL-sortable SequentialId GUID shape; added a non-RFC GUID regression instead of assuming UUID version/variant markers.
Extracted UI permission imports from the shared DTO parser. Compiler settings and assertions unchanged.
Long finding text overflowed on a 390px phone in both themes. Set the real Fluent MessageBar layout to multiline; kept viewport, width assertion, Axe and contrast thresholds.

limits: Review reports observed related facts for one selected entry; it is not a global serializable snapshot or an audit of all historical finance data.
The saved-note checkbox is not a detector of all unflagged historical discrepancies.
Historical repairs need an explicit audited Finance decision; existing M23-M25 command guards remain in force.
Human usability feedback and measured staff time savings remain unverified.
Working Entra/provider accounts and Hostinger VPS acceptance remain separate authorized gates.
